# Metasploit Framework

`metasploit` &middot; _exploitation-tools_

The standard exploitation framework: search, scan with auxiliary modules, and use exploits.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- Installed on demand; it is large (several hundred MB).
- A target in scope and an understanding of the module you run.
- Explicit authorisation for any exploit or scanner action.

## How to use it

`msfconsole` opens an interactive session. This app wires the auxiliary scanner path so you can run non-destructive checks (e.g. auxiliary/scanner/http/http_version) from a form. Exploit modules are launched in the terminal, deliberately not automated.

## Examples

```console
$ msfconsole -q -x 'use auxiliary/scanner/portscan/tcp; set RHOSTS 192.168.1.10; run; exit'
```
